name: Computational Geometry
desc: Computational approaches for problems in geometry.

resources.name: Convex Hull
resources.desc: The convex hull of a shape is the smallest convex set that contains it.

resources.name: Convex Hull Algorithms
resources.desc: A website with visualizations of many convex hull algorithms, including gift wrapping, Graham's scan, quickhull, divide and conquer, monotone chain, and Chan's algorithm.

resources.name: Chan's Algorithm
resources.desc: An optimal output-sensitive algorithm to compute the convex hull of a set of points in 2 or 3 dimensions.

resources.name: Kirkpatrick's Point location
resources.desc: A data structure and method for point location with O(n) space and O(log n) query time using triangulation.

resources.name: Voronoi Diagrams
resources.desc: A partition of a plane into regions close to a given set of points.

resources.name: Fortune's Algorithm
resources.desc: A sweep line algorithm for generating the Voronoi diagram in O(n log n) time and O(n) space.

resources.name: k-d tree
resources.desc: A method of partitioning k-dimensional space in an efficient way for searches like nearest neighbors.

resources.name: Configuration Space
resources.desc: The space of possible configurations of an object like a robot.

resources.name: Computational Geometry: Algorithms and Applications
resources.desc: A textbook by Mark de Berg, Otfried Cheong, Marc van Kreveld, and Mark Overmars (2008).

resources.name: Computational Geometry in C
resources.desc: A popular introduction to the design and implementation of geometry algorithms arising in areas such as computer graphics, robotics, and engineering design by Joseph O'Rourke (1998).

resources.name: Computational Geometry: An Introduction
resources.desc: An introductory textbook by Franco P. Preparata and Michael I. Shamos (1993).

resources.name: Algorithmic Geometry
resources.desc: A textbook by Jean-Daniel Boissonnat, Mariette Yvinec, and Herve Bronniman (1998).

resources.name: Discrete and Computational Geometry
resources.desc: A comprehensive yet accessible introduction to the intermingling of discrete geometry, a relatively new development in pure mathematics, and computational geometry, an emerging area in applications-driven computer science by Satyan L. Devadoss and Joseph O'Rourke (2011).

resources.name: Interactive Computational Geometry - A taxonomic approach
resources.desc: An interactive introduction to some of the fundamental algorithms of computational geometry with Mathematica by Jim Arlow (2014).

resources.name: Lecture Notes
resources.desc: Lecture notes from CMSC 754 Computational Geometry at the University of Maryland by David Mount (2002).

resources.name: Handbook of Discrete and Computational Geometry
resources.desc: A handbook by Jacob E. Goodman, Joseph O'Rourke, and Csaba D. Tóth (2017).

resources.name: Handbook of Computational Geometry
resources.desc: An overview of key concepts and results in computational geometry by J. R. Sack, and J. Urrutia (1998).

resources.name: Computing in Euclidean Geometry
resources.desc: A collection of surveys and exploratory articles about recent developments in the field of computational Euclidean geometry by Ding-Zhu Du and Frank Hwang (1995).

resources.name: CGAL
resources.desc: A software project that provides easy access to efficient and reliable geometric algorithms in the form of a C++ library. This website also has explanations of many of these algorithms.

resources.name: Wykobi
resources.desc: An extremely efficient, robust, and simple to use C++ 2D/3D oriented computational geometry library.

resources.name: geometry3Sharp
resources.desc: Open-Source, Boost-licensed C# library for geometric computing.

resources.name: Computational Geometry Software Libraries
resources.desc: UIUC's large collection and library of geometric software by Jeff Erickson.

resources.name: The Stony Brook Algorithm Repository
resources.desc: A repository of algorithms based on The Algorithm Design Manual.

resources.name: Geometric Tools
resources.desc: A library of source code for computing in the fields of mathematics, graphics, image analysis, and physics that includes some computational geometry algorithms.

resources.name: GeoLib
resources.desc: A fast and efficient computational geometry library available in C++, C# and Java.

resources.name: hull.js
resources.desc: JavaScript library that builds the convex hull of a set of points.

resources.name: S2 Geometry Library
resources.desc: A package for manipulating geometric shapes. Unlike many geometry libraries, S2 is primarily designed to work with spherical geometry, i.e., shapes drawn on a sphere rather than on a planar 2D map. This makes it especially suitable for working with geographic data.

resources.name: Computational Geometry Unity Library
resources.desc: A library of computational geometry algorithms for Unity.

resources.name: Symposium on Computational Geometry
resources.desc: An annual symposium.

resources.name: The Canadian Conference on Computational Geometry
resources.desc: An annual international event for the dissemination of new results in the fields of computational and combinatorial geometry. The conference is usually held in a Canadian city sometime in mid-August.

resources.name: Japan Conference on Discrete and Computational Geometry, Graphs, and Games
resources.desc: A conference held annually since 1997, except for 2008.

resources.name: Symposium on Discrete Algorithms
resources.desc: ACM-SIAM, held annually.

resources.name: Annual ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing
resources.desc: STOC covers all areas of research within Algorithms and Computation Theory.

resources.name: IEEE Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science
resources.desc: The flagship conference sponsored by the IEEE Computer Society Technical Committee on the Mathematical Foundations of Computing (TCMF) and covers a broad range of theoretical computer science.

resources.name: Annual Allerton Conference on Communications, Control and Computing
resources.desc: Draws some of the brightest minds from industry, academia, and government to discuss innovation in the fields of communication, control, and computing.

resources.name: arXiv
resources.desc: Recent submissions to arXiv about computational geometry.

resources.name: Elsevier
resources.desc: A forum for research in theoretical and applied aspects of computational geometry.

resources.name: Journal of Computational Geometry
resources.desc: An international open access journal devoted to publishing original research of the highest quality in all aspects of computational geometry.

resources.name: HackerEarth
resources.desc: A set of articles on computational geometry.

resources.name: TopCoder
resources.desc: A set of articles on computational geometry.

resources.name: HackerRank
resources.desc: A set of programming problems using computational geometry.

resources.name: GeeksforGeeks
resources.desc: Implementations and explanations for a large number of commonly asked questions and common topics in geometric algorithms.

resources.name: MIT OCW
resources.desc: A course taught by Nicholas Patrikalakis and Takashi Maekawa in 2013.

resources.name: Udemy
resources.desc: A course about implementing computational geometry algorithms in C++.

resources.name: edX
resources.desc: A course in computational geometry.

resources.name: Brilliant
resources.desc: Practice problems for basic concepts in computational geometry.

resources.name: Brown University
resources.desc: A course taught by Roberto Tamassia in 2005.

resources.name: Washington University in St. Louis
resources.desc: A course taught by Tao Ju in 2017.

resources.name: The University of Maryland
resources.desc: A course taught by Dave Mount in 2002.

resources.name: UC Santa Barbara
resources.desc: A course taught by Subhash Suri in 2021.

resources.desc: A course taught by Jonathan Shewchuk in 2019.

resources.name: KIT
resources.desc: A course taught by Tamara Mchedlidze and Chih-Hung Liu in 2018.

resources.name: The Open Problems Project
resources.desc: A project aimed to record important open problems in computational geometry and related fields.

resources.name: Wolfram
resources.desc: Documentation for computational geometry algorithms implemented in the Wolfram language.

resources.name: Matlab
resources.desc: Documentation for computational geometry algorithms implemented in the Matlab.
